description: The input box of an AI chat. It grows with the message, takes files by the paperclip, a drop or a paste, opens orders, people or commands at the caret after @ and /, and its Send key turns into a spinner and then Stop while the reply comes in.
moves: Send, the spinner and Stop cross-fade in place as the status changes; with more motion they also turn and blur through the swap and land with a pop.
Send, Stop and the toolbar buttons give under the pointer and spring back on release.
The row of files opens to its height when the first file arrives and closes as the last one leaves, so the text moves instead of jumping.
Each file pops in from smaller, its upload line fills along its foot, and it shrinks away when removed while the files after it close the gap.
The suggestions unfold from the caret, their rows cascade in, and one highlight glides between them as you arrow through.
While files are dragged over the box, a drop layer fades in over it and its label rises; the box leans toward the files.
The model picker's choice rises into place, and on a phone the models open as a sheet from the bottom.
keyboard: Sends the message. With submitOn="mod+enter" it starts a new line instead. While suggestions are open, it inserts the highlighted one. Nothing sends while an input method is composing.
Opens mentions at the caret, or commands at the start of the message.
Move through the open suggestions; Tab or Enter inserts one, Escape closes them.
Moves from the message to attach, the model, your actions and Send.

propDocs.PromptComposer.status: "ready", "submitted" (Send shows a spinner), "streaming" (Send becomes Stop) or "error" (shows errorMessage).
propDocs.PromptComposer.onSubmit: Called with { text, attachments, model } when Send is pressed, a send key is used or an agent submits. The composer empties itself afterwards.
propDocs.PromptComposer.onStop: Called when Stop is pressed while a reply is on its way.
propDocs.PromptComposer.submitOn: "enter" (Shift+Enter for a new line) or "mod+enter" (Enter for a new line). Cmd/Ctrl+Enter always sends.
propDocs.PromptComposer.mentions: Items @ suggests: { value, label, description?, icon?, group?, keywords? }. Choosing one inserts @ and its label.
propDocs.PromptComposer.commands: Items / suggests at the start of the message, in the same shape as mentions.
propDocs.PromptComposer.models: Shows a model picker: { value, label, description? }. Use model, defaultModel and onModelChange to control it.
propDocs.PromptComposer.accept: Which files can be attached, like "image/*,.pdf". false hides the paperclip and turns off drops and pastes.
propDocs.PromptComposer.upload: (file, { onProgress, signal }) => Promise. Each file uploads as soon as it is attached; Send waits for it.
propDocs.PromptComposer.maxRows: How many lines the message grows to before it scrolls. Default 8.
propDocs.PromptComposer.counter: "characters", "tokens" (an estimate) or "none". With maxLength the count reads against the limit.
propDocs.PromptComposer.actions: Your own buttons, placed after attach and the model picker.
propDocs.PromptComposer.menuController: A controller from createPromptComposerMenuController, to open @ or / from a button.
